description: This is an HTML file implementing a web-based database viewer interface with embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic data loading, table rendering, and user interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and updates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list upon user request

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for a data table from data rows

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long text

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for large or object data
